propositions: BindingRepository must preserve exact byte layout (sorted, indented, newline) when serializing binding state files to disk, with construction performing no eager writes.
Corrupt live JSON must fail closed with ValueError and preserve the file; corrupt retired JSON must fail open returning empty with best-effort alerting and preserve the file.

Rotation persistence failure must leave the sidecar file old, replace live with new bytes retaining inline last_get_pass, and not raise; subsequent saves must converge the sidecar from the retained floor.
Live and retired write failures must raise after cleaning temporary files; rotation write failure must not raise but must preserve the inline floor in the live replacement.
Alert persistence failure must be swallowed without altering the successful state-file persistence result.
Save must execute rotation persistence before live replacement, maintaining the current retired-first and rotation-before-live ordering without claiming multi-file atomicity or write elision.
